G5286.definition: (ὑπό, πούς),  ; a footstool (= cl. θρᾶνος): Jas.2:3; metaphorically, Mat.5:35, Mrk.12:36 (ὑποκάτω, WH, R, mg.), Luk.20:43, Act.2:35 7:49, Heb.1:13 10:13 (all, except Mt, l.with, from LXX, Psa.110:1, Isa.66:1) (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 223).†; (AS)

G5273.definition: ὑπο-κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ; (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see)  ; 1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.). ; 2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite: Mat.6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51, Mrk.7:6 Luk.6:42 12:56 13:15.†; (AS)

G5219.definition: to listen, attend, hence, ; (a) to answer a knock at a door (Plat., Xen., al.): Act.12:13; (b) to attend to, submit to, obey (Hdt., Thuc., al.): absol., Php.2:12; with inf., Heb.11:8; with dative of person(s) (Plat., al.; but more frequently with genitive), Mat.8:27, Mrk.1:27 4:41, Luk.8:25 17:6, Rom.6:16, Eph.6:1, 5, Col.3:20, 22, Heb.5:9, 1Pe.3:6; with dative of thing(s), Act.6:7, Rom.6:12 10:16, 2Th.1:8 3:14…

G5221.definition: ὑπ-αντάω, -ῶ; to go to meet, meet: with dative of person(s) (see M, Pr., 64), Mat.8:28 28:9, Mrk.5:2, Luk.8:27 17:12 (ἀπ-, WH, txt.), Jhn.4:51 11:20, 30 12:18, Act.16:16; of meeting in battle, Luk.14:31.†; (AS)

G5222.definition: ὑπ-άντησις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑπαντάω),  ; a going to meet: εἰς ὑ. (see M, Pro.14:1-35 n), Mat.8:34 25:1, Jhn.12:13.†; (AS)

G5278.definition: ὑπο-μένω; 1. in-trans., to stay behind: before ἐν, Luk.2:43; ἐκεῖ, Act.17:14. ; 2. Trans., ; (a) with accusative, to await, wait for: Rom.8:24 (Hom., Hdt., Xen., al.); (b) of things, to bear patiently, endure: absol., Mat.10:22 24:13, Mrk.13:13, 2Ti.2:12, Jas.5:11, 1Pe.2:20; τ. θλίψει (dative of circumstance), Rom.12:12; before εἰς, Heb.12:7; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.13:7, 2Ti.2:10, Heb.10:32 12:2-3…

G5225.definition: 1. to begin, make a beginning (Hom., Hdt., al.). ; 2. to be in existence, be ready, be at hand (Hdt., Thuc., al.): Act.19:40 27:12, 21; before ἐν, Act.28:18. ; 3. to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition (cf. G5268.definition: ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον; under the yoke; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: Mat.21:5 (LXX), 2Pe.2:16.†; (AS)

G5270.definition: ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr., 99),; below, under: as prep. with genitive, Mat.22:44, Mrk.6:11 7:28 12:36 (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), Luk.8:16, Jhn.1:51, Heb.2:8" (LXX), Rev.5:3, 13 6:9 12:1.†; (AS)

G5272.definition: ὑπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see)  ; 1. a reply, answer (Hdt.). ; 2. play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, pretence, hypocrisy: Mat.23:28, Mrk.12:15, Luk.12:1, Gal.2:13, 1Ti.4:2, 1Pe.2:1 (Polyb., Pss Sng.4:7).†; (AS)

G5214.definition: (ὕμνος)  ; 1. trans., with accusative of person(s) (in cl. also with accusative of thing(s)), to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of: Act.16:25, Heb.2:12. ; 2. Intrans., to sing: in LXX and NT, of singing hymns and praises to God (Psa.65:13, al.), Mat.26:30, Mrk.14:26 (see Swete, in l).†; (AS)
renderings: when they had sung a hymn

G5243.definition: (ὑπερήφανος, which see),  ; haughtiness, arrogance, disdain: Mrk.7:22 (Plat., Xen.).†; (AS)

G5298.definition: ὑπο-χωρέω; to go back, retire: before ἐν, Luk.5:16; before εἰς, Luk.9:10.†; (AS)

G5215.definition: a hymn; (a) in cl. a festal song in praise of gods or heroes; (b) in LXX and NT a song of praise addressed to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16.†; SYN.: ψαλμός, that which is sung to a musical accompaniment; ᾠδή, the generic term for song (cf. Tr., Syn., § LXXviii, Lft. on Col.3:16) (AS)

G5251.definition: ὑπερ-υψόω, -ῶ; 1. to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place: Php.2:9. ; 2. to extol (Da, ll. with).†; (AS)

G5227.definition: ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον; set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), Col.2:14; absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., Heb.10:27 (cf. Isa.26:11).†; (AS)

G5233.definition: ὑπερ-βαίνω; 1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: 1Th.4:6). ; 2. Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, 1Th.4:6 (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).†; (AS)

G5232.definition: ὑπερ-αυξάνω ; to increase beyond measure: 2Th.1:3 (see Lft., Notes, 98).†; (AS)

G5250.definition: ὑπερ-πλεονάζω ; to abound exceedingly: 1Ti.1:14 (Ps Sol 5:19; Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).†; (AS)

G5296.definition: ὑπο-τύπωσις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑποτυπόω, to delineate), ; an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, a pattern, example: 1Ti.1:16, 2Ti.1:13.†; SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see DB, iii, 696b) (AS)

G5202.definition: ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ; (ὕδωρ, πίνω),  ; to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†; (AS)

G5280.definition: ὑπόμινησις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑπομιμνήσκω)  ; a reminding, reminder: ἐν ὑ., 2Pe.1:13 3:1; with genitive, 2Ti.1:5.†; (AS)

G5289.definition: ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ; (ὑποστέλλω), ; 1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.). ; 2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Heb.10:39.†; (AS)

G5226.definition: ὑπ-είκω; 1. to retire, withdraw. ; 2. to yield, submit: metaphorically, Heb.13:17.†; (AS)

G5208.definition: 1. wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.). ; 2. wood, timber, fuel (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): Jas.3:5 (see Hort, Ja., 70, 104 f.). ; 3. = Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).†; (AS)

G5277.definition: ὑπο-λιμτάνω ; collat. form of ὑπολείπω, ; to leave behind: 1Pe.2:21.†; (AS)

G5261.definition: (ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying),  ; 1. a writing-copy, hence, ; 2. an example: 1Pe.2:11 (Philo).†; (AS)

G5246.definition: ὑπέρ-ογκος, -ον; of excessive weight or size; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., 2Pe.2:18, Ju 16.†; (AS)

G5254.definition: ὑπ-έχω; to hold or put under. Metaphorical, to undergo, suffer: δίκην, Ju 7 (Soph., Eur., al.).†; (AS)
